capabilities.title: Immutable Revision timeline and read-only preview
capabilities.contract: The timeline distinguishes initial, manual, AI-assisted, and restored Revisions. Selecting a Revision is local-only and does not alter the Article or Draft; revision conflicts use an application contract rather than persistence types.
capabilities.persistence: Revisions are immutable local records ordered by creation.

capabilities.title: Restore a prior Revision
capabilities.contract: Restoring a prior Revision creates a new Revision and never rewrites history; uncommitted Drafts require an explicit choice, and stale revision conflicts remain application-owned.
capabilities.persistence: Restoration appends a new immutable local Revision.

capabilities.title: Versioned local writing samples and explicit compact style profile rebuild
capabilities.contract: Authors manage included local samples, explicitly confirmed immutable Revision snapshots, and global rules; duplicate text is rejected and removal requires confirmation. For explicitly submitted text without a source name, the configured text-generation model names the sample while Submit shows loading. Input changes leave the current profile visible but outdated until explicit rebuild creates a version and Assistant service message. The profile identifies exact contributors and rebuild time.
capabilities.persistence: Raw samples, immutable Article Revision provenance, global rules, Article-specific rules, generated source names, and append-only compact profile versions remain local; Style Profile exposes a short local sample excerpt for author recognition.

capabilities.title: Revision-tied findings, citations, uncertainty, and stale indication
capabilities.contract: Findings remain advisory, Revision-tied, cited, uncertain, stale-aware, and actionable from Fact Check or Assistant. Fact Check shows status badges, selected-finding navigation, concise Revision numbers, and independently scrolling navigation and detail panes. Accepting a finding records only local advisory resolution and creates no Revision. Accepting a correction Proposal marks covered findings corrected or removed; remaining findings become stale with the new Revision.
capabilities.persistence: Findings and citations persist locally without modifying Article text; focused updates to other editorial artifacts do not replace or detach their citations.

capabilities.title: Linked translation Articles with source freshness protection
capabilities.contract: Translations are independently recoverable linked Articles. The workspace starts configured target-language requests through Assistant messages, restores the latest completed proposal per language, and supports language navigation. Source Articles list linked translations; each translation links back and identifies the source Revision. Source and translation appear with full language names side by side, with paragraph and Markdown-list alignment where possible, plus validated protected spans and stale-source warnings. The selected translation shows advisory character guidance for the Article's selected publishing profile. Created translations open in the editor for author-controlled Drafts and Revisions; stale proposals cannot create them.
capabilities.persistence: Completed translation proposals persist in local Assistant artifacts; Source Article and Revision linkage persist on the independently recoverable translation Article.

capabilities.title: Explicit Markdown and plain-text copying with character guidance
capabilities.contract: The Status Bar main action copies current Article Markdown, while its menu offers Markdown or deterministically prepared plain text. Article-specific profile guidance, including configured custom profiles, remains available beside it. Copying is explicit and direct publishing is not performed.
capabilities.persistence: Copied output is derived from the local Article and locally persisted profile data.

capabilities.title: Named profiles with configurable limits
capabilities.contract: Authors choose a predefined default for new Articles and configure named custom non-negative limits with stable IDs. Each Article independently selects Default, No restrictions, LinkedIn Post, LinkedIn Article, or a custom profile for advisory guidance.
capabilities.persistence: The default profile and custom name/limit persist locally in app_settings.publish-limit-profile; Article-specific selection persists locally.

scenarios.title: Revision history is browsable without changing Article content
preconditions: An Article has initial and subsequent Revisions.
scenarios.event: The author selects an earlier Revision in history.
expected: A formatted read-only preview and distinct provenance timeline icon are shown.
forbidden: Selecting history does not alter the current Article or Draft.

scenarios.title: Restoring preserves immutable Revision history
preconditions: An author has selected an earlier Revision.
expected: The restore request identifies the selected Revision and the repository creates a new Revision.
forbidden: Existing Revision records are not rewritten.

scenarios.title: Style corpus stays local while a compact profile is derived
preconditions: The author adds a writing sample, optionally without a source name.
scenarios.event: The style corpus or global rules change.
expected: A submitted blank source name is generated with the configured text model; a confirmed Article Revision snapshot retains its source Revision; removing a sample requires confirmation; the current profile is marked outdated until an explicit rebuild creates the next compact version, and the rebuild is recorded in the selected Article's Assistant chat.
forbidden: Raw style samples are not treated as remote application data except for the author-explicit name-generation request.

scenarios.title: Fact findings remain advisory and Revision-tied
preconditions: The author requests a fact check for the current Revision.
expected: Findings retain source citations, uncertainty, and the reviewed Revision identifier.
forbidden: Fact-check output does not modify Article text.

scenarios.title: Stale source content blocks linked translation creation
preconditions: A translation proposal's source Revision is stale.
forbidden: Creating a translation Article is disabled until a current translation is generated.

scenarios.title: Header copy offers Markdown and plain text without direct publishing
preconditions: The current Article has a selected publishing profile.
scenarios.event: The author uses the Status Bar Copy control.
expected: The main action copies Markdown and the menu offers deterministic plain text without AI.
forbidden: The application does not publish directly to a platform.

scenarios.title: Publishing profile selection persists locally
preconditions: A publishing default and custom profile name/limit are configured.
scenarios.event: The service saves and reloads that selection.
expected: The selected default and valid custom profile configuration are returned after reload.
forbidden: Unknown profiles and invalid custom limits are not accepted.
